_schema: Idle loot (decisions row 33; Game Modes and Progression Plan, Idle rewards). Rate per hour at highest cleared stage s >= 1 grows by the same factor every stage, through at30 (stage 30) and at600 (stage 600): at30 x (at600 / at30)^((s - 30) / 570); nothing cleared = 0. The chest stops after capHours until you collect. An Hourglass pays hourglassHours at the current rate, outside the cap.
